title: Direct Recruitment to various posts in Government of India
content:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau UPSC Direct Recruitment to various posts in Government of India Posted On:
                23 MAY 2026 10:33AM by PIB Delhi UPSC invites applications from eligible candidates for direct recruitment to various posts in Government of India. The detailed Advertisement No. 05/2026 , along-with instructions to the candidates have been uploaded on the Commission’s website https://upsc.gov.in . Interested candidates can apply through the Online Recruitment Application portal https://upsconline.nic.in/ora/ from 23 rd May, 2026 to 12 th June, 2026 . Candidates are requested to follow the detailed instructions mentioned therein. ******* NKR/AK/GM (Release ID: 2264428) Visitor Counter : 220 Read this release in: Marathi , Gujarati UPSC Direct Recruitment to various posts in Government of India Posted On:
